tooling.docid_mapping: Use native structured docid/document_id first. On returns without a native ID, match exact corpus URL or frontmatter/title only when one corpus doc is identified. Use open arguments only to verify a full-text return; arguments do not count as a return ID by themselves.
tooling.full_open: Require full returned text to match the identified fixed corpus document by SHA-256.
tooling.gate: Both search and open require a measured return DocID ratio of at least 0.8. A class with no returns has no measurable ratio.
tooling.query_repeat: NFKC, casefold and whitespace folding for exact repetition. Otherwise use Unicode word-token set Jaccard at least 0.8.
tooling.record_scope: Completed or failed tool returns are denominators; raw search JSON supplies IDs.
tooling.runtime: Slurm CPU only. Model requests and network requests by the check script are zero.
tooling.timing: State is updated after the whole round. Queries and documents in parallel siblings cannot affect one another.
tooling.visibility_scope: Agent exposure requires a verified next-prompt visibility receipt from 187221 and an exact match to the raw return.
